content.name: Paul Nguyen
content.title: Junior Design Engineer (Konstruktion)
content.summary: Junior mechanical design engineer with an M.Sc. in Mechanical Engineering from TUM and hands-on experience in drive technology and conveyor systems. Works in Siemens NX and CATIA, applies DIN EN ISO 12100 risk assessment, and cut the weight of a conveyor frame by 18% in my first year.

experience.title: Werkstudent Konstruktion (working student, design)
bullets: Modelled gearbox housings and adapter flanges in Siemens NX for customer-specific drive variants, about 16 hours a week.
Created technical drawings to DIN EN ISO standards and updated parts lists in the PDM system.
Wrote my master's thesis with the team on topology optimisation of a gearbox housing, saving 11% mass in simulation.

experience.title: Junior Design Engineer (Konstrukteur)
bullets: Design modules for roller and belt conveyor systems used in warehouse logistics, from concept to production drawings.
Redesigned a conveyor frame with sheet-metal parts instead of welded profiles, cutting weight by 18% and assembly time by about a fifth.
Prepare risk assessments to DIN EN ISO 12100 and technical file inputs for CE marking under the Machinery Directive.
Support commissioning at two customer sites and feed findings back into the design standards.

education.details: Final grade 1.7; thesis on topology optimisation of gearbox housings
